event.description: Reduce the learned positional factorization from retained rank 6 to rank 5 while retaining the 45000-step learning-rate-floor schedule, d=14, h=2, L=2, and ff=20.
event.proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 3332 parameters at 99.710000%, a +0.710000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0026, learned positional rank 6 (3332, 99.71%); the most recent failed result in this mechanism is attempt-0017, fixed-basis rank-8 expansion, an optimization failure, while the earlier rank-6 standard-schedule failure was superseded by the changed-condition accepted rank-6 result; 6 prior position-representation macro-attempts plus the rank-7 schedule reattempt. Hypothesis: rank 5 may retain enough learned position-specific role capacity under the successful 45000-step nonzero-tail schedule, reducing actual parameters from 3332 to 3283. This is a representational positional factorization, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. It is more informative than the nearest untested rank-4 alternative because rank 5 directly maps the next one-coordinate compression boundary from a qualifying rank-6 incumbent.
